summarize.label: Summarize this page
summarize.prompt: Summarize this page: start with a one- or two-sentence overview, then list the key points.

keyPoints.label: Key points
keyPoints.prompt: Extract the key information from this page (conclusions, data, steps, caveats, etc.) as a list. Don't leave out important details.

explain.label: Explain in Chinese
explain.prompt: In Simplified Chinese, explain what this page is about, who it's for, and the parts most worth attention.

placeholder.notConfigured: Configure a chat model in settings first
placeholder.withTools: Ask about this page, or let the AI use page tools to do something for you…
placeholder.default: Ask about this page, e.g. "What's the conclusion of this article?"

chat.inputHint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line

empty.title: How can I help?
empty.description: Summarize pages or ask questions about them. Select text on a page and click "Ask AI" — it opens here with the selection attached.
empty.descriptionWithTools: Summarize pages or ask questions about them. Select text on a page and click "Ask AI" — it opens here with the selection attached. This page also provides {count} tools, which the AI can use to act on it for you.
empty.descriptionWithTools_one: Summarize pages or ask questions about them. Select text on a page and click "Ask AI" — it opens here with the selection attached. This page also provides {count} tool, which the AI can use to act on it for you.

tool.mayModify: This tool may modify page data

settings.modelHint: Used by the side panel assistant and selection actions like explain, summarize, and polish. Pick a capable model that supports tool calling. The translation model is configured separately in settings and can be a faster one.
settings.modelHintInherited: Used by the side panel assistant and selection actions like explain, summarize, and polish. Pick a capable model that supports tool calling. The translation model is configured separately in settings and can be a faster one. Currently following the translation model; saving makes it separate.

agent.maxStepsHistory_one: The model has called a tool {count} time in a row without finishing, so it stopped here. You can add details and continue.

errors.noResponse: The page didn't respond. Refresh the page and try again
errors.scriptNotReady: DevGo's script on this page isn't ready. Refresh the page and try again
errors.navigatedNoResult: The tool ran, but the page navigated and no result was found on the new page
errors.toolMissing: Tool "{name}" wasn't found on this page

errors.llmNotConfigured: AI translation isn't configured: enter the base URL and model in settings

unsupported.title: WebMCP isn't enabled yet
unsupported.description: WebMCP is currently an experimental Chrome feature. It needs Chrome 150 or later: search for "WebMCP for testing" in chrome://flags, enable it, restart the browser, then come back and refresh.

unavailable.title: This page can't be read
unavailable.description: Browser built-in pages, the extension store, and similar pages don't allow extension access. If this is a normal web page, refresh it and try again.

loading.title: Checking this page…
loading.description: Reading tools registered by the page and its iframes.

empty.title: This page doesn't provide any tools
empty.description: A page must register tools via WebMCP (document.modelContext) before the AI can act on it directly.

webmcp.summary: This page provides {count} tools. Describe what you need in Chat and the AI will call them
webmcp.summary_one: This page provides {count} tool. Describe what you need in Chat and the AI will call it
